PullRequest.Title: sessions: polish connector recommendations
PullRequest.Body: Follow-up to #341844; relates to #341452. Companion product copy: microsoft/vscode-distro#1470. ## Summary Polish the new-session connector recommendations into a quieter, task-led discovery surface. - Show one randomly selected recommendation per component instance. Keep it stable while open; dismissal hides the surface for that view and returns focus to chat without showing a replacement. - Remove connector-name headings; use 16px product icons, muted 12px text, tighter spacing, and a native compact close action with a 24px target. - Read recommendation descriptions directly from product metadata for every connector, including known IDs. Task-based copy is owned by the companion microsoft/vscode-distro#1470; the renderer has no connector-specific description overrides. - Add standard connector-specific tooltips with keyboard dismissal, preserve accessible names and decorative-icon semantics, and update accessibility help. - Preserve existing experiment/capability gates and connector-detail navigation. Clicking a recommendation does not automatically connect an account or submit an agent prompt. ## Screenshots Cropped, 2x-resolution captures of the implemented component (not the HTML mockup), using fixture product metadata matching microsoft/vscode-distro#1470. The new task copy reaches the product after the distro PR merges and its merged revision is picked up through the usual distro update; until then this generic renderer displays existing product descriptions. ### Dark theme ### Light theme ### Connector tooltip ### Narrow layout ## How to test 1. In Component Explorer, open `sessions/chat/newWidget/newChatWidget/ConnectorRecommendations` and its narrow, phone, WorkIQ, fallback-icon, and dismissed variants. Fixtures use a single configured connector for deterministic screenshots; unit tests cover random selection across the catalog. 2. Hover the recommendation to see its connector-specific tooltip; press Escape to hide the tooltip. 3. Use Tab/Shift+Tab between the recommendation and its close action. Dismiss with Enter or Space: no replacement should appear and focus should return to the input. 4. Check dark, light, and both high-contrast themes. Confirm the longer Notion task wraps without overlapping either icon. ## Validation Commands used the repository-required Node runtime via `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 --`. - `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 -- node build\next\build-fast.ts --client-only` - passed after merging current main. - `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 -- .\scripts\test.bat --run src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\test\browser\newChatConnectorRecommendations.test.ts --run src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\test\browser\sessionsChatAccessibilityHelp.test.ts --reporter dot` - 51 passed after merging current main. - `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 -- npm.cmd run typecheck-client` - passed after applying the one-line upstream duplicate-property fix from a32f4c90bc5d833a01a09a1a4190cb06dec5994b. - `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 -- node build\eslint.ts src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\browser\newChatConnectorRecommendations.ts src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\test\browser\newChatConnectorRecommendations.test.ts src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\test\browser\newChatWidget.fixture.ts` - passed; the other changed TypeScript files also passed targeted lint earlier in this session. - `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 -- node build\stylelint.ts src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\browser\media\newChatConnectorRecommendations.css` - passed. - Component Explorer: all 32 connector fixtures rendered without errors before the main merge. - Real-browser checks before the main merge: tooltip visibility/Escape dismissal, Tab/Shift+Tab navigation, visible focus, 24px close target, Space dismissal, and focus restoration passed in all four themes. Text contrast ratios: 5.18:1 dark, 11.20:1 light, 21:1 high-contrast dark, 14.55:1 high-contrast light. - `git diff --check` - passed. NVDA and live connector authentication were not exercised. ### Product-copy ownership correction Removed the renderer's ID-based description overrides. The known-connector regression test deliberately supplies different product descriptions and verifies they are rendered unchanged. Client build, 51 targeted tests, ESLint, and scoped hygiene passed after this correction. - `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 -- node build\hygiene.ts src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\browser\newChatConnectorRecommendations.ts src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\test\browser\newChatConnectorRecommendations.test.ts src\vs\sessions\contrib\chat\test\browser\newChatWidget.fixture.ts` - passed. ### CI repairs - Applied the existing one-line upstream fix for the duplicate `gitService` property in the Git state test fixture; no runtime behavior changes. - Refreshed three reviewed connector screenshot pins. All 79 pinned hashes match the CI manifest (1,694 screenshots, zero render errors). - `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 -- .\scripts\test.bat --run src\vs\platform\agentHost\test\node\agentHostGitStateService.test.ts --grep AgentHostGitStateService --reporter dot` - 88 passed. - `npm.cmd exec --yes --package=node@24.18.0 -- node build\hygiene.ts src\vs\platform\agentHost\test\node\agentHostGitStateService.test.ts` - passed. - `node build\lib\screenshotBlocksCi.ts .screenshot-review\screenshots\manifest.json .screenshot-review\blocks-ci-screenshots.lf.md https://hediet-screenshots.azurewebsites.net` - passed against the downloaded CI manifest with LF-normalized baseline content. - Both fixes have been pushed; fresh CI results are pending.

Scenarios.Scenario: Create and render a new-session composer with connector recommendation metadata present
Scenarios.CriticalPath: NewChatView constructs and renders NewChatWidget, which synchronously constructs NewChatConnectorRecommendations, enumerates product metadata, creates one card/action/hover registration, and assigns one icon URL. The remote image load is asynchronous and is not required for composer interaction or layout progress.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Assign an HTTPS product icon URL to a lazy HTMLImageElement, allowing the browser to fetch/decode the image.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one icon load per NewChatWidget instance when the selected recommendation has a valid HTTPS/data icon; zero for absent metadata or fallback icons. Before the diff, every catalog recommendation was rendered and could initiate an icon load (three for the documented catalog).
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same helper and image boundary ran once for every recommendation; the diff reduces effective cardinality to one selected entry.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The image is lazy and failure falls back to a codicon; it does not block synchronous widget construction or input readiness.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Synchronous Object.entries still scales with catalog size N, as before, while DOM controls, listeners, and image work decrease from N recommendation cards to one per widget.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One selected icon may load asynchronously per live NewChatWidget. Multiple live new-session views can each create one card, but the diff reduces aggregate icon concurrency from N per view to one and adds no queue or burst mechanism.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Product metadata is in-memory. HTTPS image reuse is delegated to the browser cache; cold construction can fetch one image, while warm construction normally reuses browser cache state. No application cache key or negative-cache behavior changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: constructor call flow, one-card selection, lifecycle registration, and image assignment are directly visible.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The number of concurrently open new-session views and browser cache hit rate vary, but both the changed cardinality and reduction from all recommendations to one are explicit.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The changed path materially reduces DOM, listener, and image-load work; the added single hover/action registration is bounded and disposed with the widget.

Scenarios.Scenario: Change theme, toggle recommendation gates, hover, or dismiss the recommendation during the widget lifetime
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Configuration events only recompute hidden state; dismissal sets a boolean, hides the group, and focuses the input. Hover creation occurs only after pointer hover and its configured delay. Theme changes synchronously rebuild the selected icon DOM and assign its URL, but do not block on image loading.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: A theme change recreates the one selected image element and reassigns its icon URL, potentially consulting the browser HTTP cache.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One URL assignment per theme-change event per live recommendation component; before the diff it was one per recommendation (three for the documented catalog).
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The pre-diff theme handler rerendered every recommendation icon, so this PR lowers work and potential boundary fan-out.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: DOM replacement is synchronous but bounded to one tiny icon; image fetch/decode remains asynchronous.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Cost scales with live NewChatWidget count and theme-change/configuration-event frequency, not catalog size after construction. Each component retains one card and one hover-map entry until its owning view is disposed; before the diff it retained all cards and dismiss buttons.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Events run independently per live widget; there is no asynchronous fan-out beyond at most one icon load per widget. Hover work is user-triggered and one delayed hover is globally managed by HoverService.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Visibility toggles do not recreate the card or refetch metadata. Theme URL assignments use browser image caching. Dismissal remains stable for the component lifetime and does not select or render a replacement.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: all event handlers, DisposableStore ownership, and the HoverService delayed-hover cleanup path were traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact live-view count is product-usage dependent, but per-view resource ownership is bounded and cleanup is explicit through registered disposables.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Added hover state is one listener/map entry and is disposed; theme and visibility work are reduced or constant and do not introduce synchronous layout reads.

Scenarios.Scenario: Click the selected recommendation to open its Copilot Connector detail
Scenarios.CriticalPath: A user click awaits executeCommand, opens/pins the customization editor, then awaits CopilotConnectorsService.getConnectors before locating and displaying the requested connector. This existing command path remains the interaction's critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Load or refresh the Copilot connector catalog before opening connector detail.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One getConnectors call per explicit recommendation click. A successful catalog refresh is reused within the service refresh interval; otherwise one refresh request is issued. The diff does not create automatic clicks or per-catalog-item calls.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Clicking any pre-diff recommendation executed the same command once with that connector ID; the diff merely limits which single recommendation is displayed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: On a cold/stale catalog this lookup delays detail display; on a warm catalog it returns the in-memory connector list. This was already the exact click path before the diff.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Lookup of the selected connector scans the returned connector list once, as before. Network cardinality scales with explicit clicks and cache staleness, not with the number of product recommendations rendered.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Each click starts one awaited command. Rapid repeated clicks are not newly coalesced, but this behavior and command handler are unchanged; the diff neither adds fan-out nor raises per-click concurrency.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: CopilotConnectorsService returns its in-memory list within its refresh interval; stale/cold state invokes refresh. The diff does not alter cache keys, invalidation, failure retry behavior, or coalescing.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the click handler, command implementation, and catalog service cache path were traced directly.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Remote duration and repeated-click prevalence vary, but PR causality is absent because boundary placement and per-click count are unchanged.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The remote boundary is pre-existing and remains one call per user action.

Scenarios.Scenario: Generate sessions accessibility help and execute changed test/component-fixture paths
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Accessibility help concatenates a revised localized string after existing configuration checks. Test fixture changes run only in tests/screenshots and do not enter shipped product scenarios.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Help generation remains constant work per invocation; text length changes only by a bounded amount. Fixture screenshot count/content affects CI only, not runtime users.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: No new product concurrency, queue, lock, IPC, filesystem, database, subprocess, or network behavior is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is read or modified by the changed help string. Test-only fixture service setup has no product cache behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed code is a bounded localized string and test-only setup/assertions.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all nine changed files and all patch pages. Traced new-session construction, render/layout and theme events, hover/action cleanup, icon loading, recommendation dismissal, connector-detail navigation, catalog caching, accessibility help, and test-only changes. The PR reduces recommendation DOM and image fan-out from the full catalog to one, adds only bounded disposed UI state, and introduces no actionable performance regression.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
